results.title: Kotoko board unveil Asante Kotoko Ladies for 2026/27 season
results.content: Called Asante Kotoko Ladies, the female team will compete in the Ashanti Region Football Association’s Division One League this season.

results.title: Obuasi Sexual Abuse Case: No teacher will be shielded if evidence proves wrongdoing – Haruna Iddrisu
results.content: The Minister of Education, Haruna Iddrisu, has assured that no teacher implicated in the allegations of sexual misconduct at Obuasi Senior High School (SHS) will be shielded from prosecution if evidence establishes their culpability.

results.title: Mfantsipim @150: Haruna Iddrisu calls for collective effort to tackle indiscipline in schools
results.content: The Minister of Education, Haruna Iddrisu, has called on traditional rulers, religious leaders, parents and students to support efforts to tackle growing indiscipline in schools across the country.

results.title: The 2027 budget is a “common sense” budget – Senyo Hosi
results.content: Convener of the OneGhana Movement and Finance and Economic Policy Analyst, Senyo Hosi, has described the government's 2027 Budget as a “great common-sense budget”, praising its focus on revenue generation, expenditure discipline and economic stability.

results.title: ECG announces three-day planned power outage in parts of Ashanti Region for upgrade works
results.content: The Electricity Company of Ghana (ECG) has announced a three-day planned power outage in parts of the Ashanti Region to allow the Ghana Grid Company Limited (GRIDCo) to upgrade the transmission line between Anwomaso and the Ridge Bulk Supply Point.

results.title: Mfantsipim @ 150: Top 12 WASSCE-performing SHSs to receive GH¢2m each from GETFund – Haruna Iddrisu
results.content: The Minister of Education, Haruna Iddrisu, has announced that the 12 best-performing senior high schools in the West African Senior School Certificate Examination (WASSCE) will each benefit from GH¢2 million in GETFund support to expand their infrastructure.

results.title: Mfantsipim @ 150: Gov’t to build 10 model SHSs, upgrade 30 Category B schools – Haruna Iddrisu
results.content: The Minister of Education, Haruna Iddrisu, has announced plans by the government to construct 10 new model senior high schools across the country and upgrade 30 Category B schools to the standard of Category A institutions.

results.title: Ecobank JoyBusiness SME Fair 2026: Day Two kicks off with exciting bargains, irresistible deals at Ghud Park
results.content: The shopping excitement is back, the bargains are calling and the opportunities to discover Ghanaian-made products are getting even bigger as Day Two of the Ecobank JoyBusiness SME Fair 2026 gets underway at Ghud Park, Accra Mall.

results.title: Education Minister promises Mfantsipim School a 66-seater bus as part of its 150th anniversary celebration
results.content: The Minister of Education, Haruna Iddrisu, has pledged to provide Mfantsipim School with a 66-seater bus as part of activities marking the institution’s 150th anniversary.

results.title: Julius Debrah calls for unity as NDC elects Eastern Regional executives
results.content: Chief of Staff Julius Debrah has called on delegates participating in the NDC's Eastern Regional executive elections to uphold peace and unity, reminding them that the outcome of the contest should not divide the party.

results.title: KGL Foundation commits $2m to maintain Mfantsipim’s Alex Dadey Sports Centre
results.content: The KGL Foundation has committed an additional $2 million towards the long-term maintenance of the Alex Dadey Sports Centre at Mfantsipim School, following its commissioning as part of the school's 150th anniversary celebrations. The commitment, announced by the chairman of the anniversary celebration and KGL Group founder, Alex Apau Dadey, will provide the facility with an annual maintenance grant of $100,000 over the next 20 years. Speaking at the anniversary event, Mr Dadey said the funding was intended to ensure that the sports centre remained functional and continued to serve generations of students. results.title: Mfantsipim lessons shaped my leadership philosophy and business journey – KGL Group Chairman
results.content: Group Executive Chairman of the KGL Group of Companies, Alex Apau Dadey, says the values of discipline, resilience, consistency and perseverance instilled in him at Mfantsipim School have played a significant role in shaping his leadership philosophy and business journey.

results.title: Photos: Osabarimba Kwesi Atta welcomes Asantehene to Cape Coast for Mfantsipim’s 150th anniversary
results.content: The Paramount Chief of the Oguaa Traditional Area, Osabarimba Kwesi Atta, has welcomed the Asantehene, Otumfuo Osei Tutu II, to the Emintsimadze Palace in Cape Coast for Mfantsipim School’s 150th anniversary celebration.

results.title: Mahama, Akufo-Addo, Otumfuo expected at Agogo Manhene’s funeral
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama, former President Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo and Asantehene Otumfuo Osei Tutu II are among prominent dignitaries expected at the final funeral rites of the late Agogomanhene, Nana Kwame Akuoko Sarpong.

results.title: Here are some quality product displays at the Ecobank JoyBusiness SME Fair 2026 – Don’t miss out
results.content: The Ecobank JoyBusiness SME Fair 2026 opened at GHUD Park, Accra Mall, bringing together an impressive collection of Ghanaian businesses, established brands, entrepreneurs and service providers for a three-day celebration of enterprise, innovation and commerce.

results.title: Disqualified NDC National Youth Organizer aspirant rules out appeal
results.content: Steven Nhyira Odarteifio says he will neither protest nor appeal his disqualification from the National Democratic Congress (NDC) race for the National Youth Organizer position.

results.title: Drug trafficking isn’t a political problem; it’s an institutional one – Senyo Hosi
results.content: Convener of the OneGhana Movement and Trustee of the Ghana Coalition Against Galamsey, Senyo Hosi, has described drug trafficking in Ghana as an institutional problem, calling for stronger enforcement systems, greater accountability and adequate resources for the Narcotics Control Commission (NACOC).

results.title: 200 police officers deployed to Nalerigu NDC election grounds
results.content: About 200 unarmed police officers have arrived at the Nalerigu Senior High School, the venue for the National Democratic Congress (NDC) Regional Executive Elections, as security is heightened ahead of the polls.

results.title: We can’t rely on NAIMOS alone to fight galamsey – Senyo Hosi
results.content: Convener of the OneGhana Movement and Finance and economic policy analyst Senyo Hosi has called for a major rethink of Ghana's approach to tackling illegal mining, warning that the country cannot rely on the National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS) alone to win the fight against galamsey.

results.title: Miracles Aboagye insists State must account for 6 deaths at Manso Keniago over galamsey
results.content: Director of Communications for the New Patriotic Party (NPP), Miracles Aboagye, has condemned the killing of six Ghanaians during a confrontation involving personnel of the National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS) and residents of Manso Keniago in the Ashanti Region.

results.title: NDC is the biggest enabler of galamsey – Miracles Aboagye claims
results.content: Dennis Miracles Aboagye, Director of Communications for the Bawumia Campaign Team, has accused the governing National Democratic Congress (NDC) of enabling illegal small-scale mining, popularly known as galamsey, alleging that some party officials and government functionaries are involved in the practice while authorities appear to be taking action against other miners.

results.title: Petrol tipped to fall 8.23%, but LPG faces 21% jump – COMAC
results.content: Petrol prices could fall by up to 8.23% from November 16, 2026, while diesel prices are also expected to decline, according to the Chamber of Oil Marketing Companies (COMAC).

results.title: The fight against galamsey has failed – Senyo Hosi
results.content: Convener of the OneGhana Movement and Trustee of the Ghana Coalition Against Galamsey, Senyo Hosi, says Ghana's fight against illegal mining has failed and requires a fundamental change in strategy to address the economic and political interests sustaining the practice.

results.title: Goalkeeper Owono banned for 12 matches after collision that caused Miguel’s death
results.content: FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono has been given a 12-match suspension by the Spanish football federation's disciplinary committee after his challenge which resulted in the death of Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel.

results.title: Livestream: Newsfile discusses galamsey clash, drug busts and 2027 Budget
results.content: JoyNews’ flagship current affairs programme, Newsfile, will on Saturday, November 14, examine the government’s fight against illegal mining, recent drug trafficking operations and the key proposals in the 2027 Budget.

results.title: Waist beads speak the language of love at Ecobank-Joy Business SME Fair 2026
results.content: The Ecobank-JoyBusiness SME Fair 2026 has offered visitors more than an opportunity to shop for food, fashion, skincare products and crafts.

results.title: Asiedu Nketia urges police to act against vote-buying in party elections
results.content: The National Chairman of the National Democratic Congress (NDC), Johnson Asiedu Nketia, has urged the police and other security agencies to investigate and take appropriate action against anyone found engaging in criminal conduct during internal political party elections.

results.title: Police begin rolling out TraffiTech-GH speed camera warning signs after Mahama directive
results.content: The Ghana Police Service and road safety agencies have commenced processes for the installation of large advance warning signboards across key road corridors to alert motorists to the presence of automated TraffiTech-GH speed cameras.
